taxonomy_policies.level1: Problem, capability or application domain. Explicitly label technical domains/umbrella categories.

taxonomy_policies.level3: Mathematical algorithms, statistical methods or broad modelling frameworks; mark broad types distinctly.
taxonomy_policies.level4: Specific architectures, architecture families or system-integration patterns; explicit subtype required. Not all Level 4 records are neural model topologies.
taxonomy_policies.retained_old_ids: Deprecated records retained with replaced_by_id and not counted as active; where replacement is unknown, retain flagged legacy record.
taxonomy_policies.source_policy: Taxonomy description reviewed using documented source; do not promote entries to Independently Verified until primary evidence is directly assessed.
